ideas.pitch: A local terminal extension that traces runtime and logical errors in DSA code and generates structured debugging pathways.
ideas.problem_statement: BugWars is a high-energy coding challenge focused on debugging, problem-solving, and programming skills.
ideas.title: BugTrace Solo
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the core debugging and problem-solving focus of BugWars by tackling runtime errors directly, mirroring successful developer-tool projects.

ideas.pitch: A command-line tool that analyses competitive programming solutions for time complexity bottlenecks and suggests optimal algorithmic changes.
ideas.problem_statement: Covering concepts from DSA and Competitive Programming, the event challenges participants to turn broken code into efficient, working solutions.
ideas.title: CP Optimizer CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the code optimization and DSA criteria judged in the competition.

ideas.pitch: A strict syntax and edge-case testing harness for rapid competitive programming validation.
ideas.problem_statement: Spotting logical, syntactical, and runtime errors under time constraints.
ideas.title: SyntaxGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Helps participants spot hidden runtime and syntactical bugs quickly, aligning with the event's attention-to-detail requirement.

ideas.pitch: An interactive logic flow visualiser for complex algorithms to help debug tricky competitive programming questions.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will tackle a range of coding problems designed to test their ability to identify errors, analyze logic, optimize solutions, and think under pressure.
ideas.title: LogicTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact logic analysis bottleneck that competitors face during high-pressure timed coding rounds.

ideas.pitch: A rapid isolation environment for broken code snippets with automated assertion generation for quick validation.
ideas.problem_statement: The contest will last for 2 hours... turning broken code into efficient, working solutions.
ideas.title: SpeedDebug Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Optimized for extreme time constraints where every minute saved on debugging yields a competitive advantage.
